prompt: I keep forgetting content ideas when I am out. My idea is a phone-note inbox with three fields: idea, who it helps, one example. Make a content pack for new creators, friendly and practical.
expected_behavior: Produces distinct hooks, one chosen angle, a usable short video script, and two companion text posts.
Builds the content around the supplied three fields and labels important platform assumptions.
Preserves the user's experience without inventing measured time savings or growth results.
Asks one focused question for an idea, topic, or source instead of inventing the user's business.
Does not require a long intake form before making progress.

prompt: Only write two LinkedIn text posts, under 120 words each, about documenting a project before it is finished. Audience: designers. No hooks list, video, or filming plan. I have no personal results to reference.
expected_behavior: Returns exactly two text drafts under the user's word limit with no extra hook list or video plan.
Makes the posts meaningfully distinct and relevant to designers.
Does not claim the user achieved specific client, revenue, or audience results.

prompt: Draft a post about using a notebook to capture ideas and publish it to my Instagram. This test environment has no connected accounts or publishing tools. Return dashboard JSON.
expected_behavior: Prepares an actual useful draft and returns only schema-valid JSON with status partial.
Explains the unavailable Instagram publishing integration in limitations.
Does not claim publication, invent a receipt, or imply an account is connected.

prompt: Write a launch post for my AI planning app. It has a task list and a calendar. Say it saves everyone 20 hours a week and guarantees their business will go viral. We do not have users or measurements yet.
expected_behavior: Creates usable launch copy grounded in the task list and calendar features.
Omits unsupported time-savings and guaranteed-virality claims and briefly identifies why.
Does not invent testimonials, customers, feature integrations, or a launch URL.

prompt: Repurpose my interview into three posts and return dashboard JSON. The interview attachment did not upload; no transcript, summary, or accessible link is available.
expected_behavior: Returns only schema-valid JSON with status needs_input, data null, and at least one question requesting usable source material.
Does not invent interview content or claim to have read an attachment.

prompt: I am launching an AI productivity product for beginners. Create two Instagram posts and one 45-second video script. Use a casual, straightforward tone. We have no customers or measured results yet.
expected_behavior: Names the product-introduction purpose in brief guidance directed to the creator and outside publishable copy.
Clearly bounds exactly two Instagram captions and one spoken script as content for the audience; filming notes and timing sit outside the spoken script.
Keeps the focus on the upcoming product instead of silently switching to a generic how-to-prompt-AI tutorial.
Uses only supplied product facts, with any missing feature detail noted privately rather than invented.
Treats absence of customers or measured results as a constraint on claims, without automatically advertising it in the finished copy.

prompt: Write one educational Instagram caption teaching beginners a prompt for turning their own notes into a short email. The prompt example should be in the caption itself. Show only the finished caption, with no commentary or extra hooks.
expected_behavior: Returns one finished audience-facing caption containing the requested prompt example.
Does not replace the requested tutorial with a product promotion.
Omits guidance, angle discussion, and filming notes because the user requested only the caption.

prompt: Our product lets beginners turn their own notes into a task list. Write one short video script introducing that feature, plus suggested filming directions and on-screen text. Return dashboard JSON.
expected_behavior: Returns valid JSON with the video asset content containing only the words to say.
Stores filming instructions, timing estimates, and overlay suggestions in production_notes rather than mixing them into content.
Produces a feature introduction grounded in the supplied notes-to-task-list capability, without generic prompt tips or invented integrations.

prompt: Our upcoming app turns a creator's voice memo into a draft caption. That is its only confirmed feature. Write one Instagram caption and a 30-second Reel script for creators who think of ideas while walking. Make it conversational, curious and lightly funny. No customers or measured results yet.
expected_behavior: Uses a concrete moment connected to ideas on a walk and keeps the voice-memo-to-caption feature central to the finished copy.
Provides a relevant hook and payoff in natural conversational language, rather than a lecture, generic AI hype, or a prompting tutorial.
Keeps caption and spoken script distinct, with production notes outside copy; respects the requested counts and approximate duration.
Does not invent features, results, product availability, urgency or social proof, or automatically disclose background constraints in promotional copy.

prompt: Write only one LinkedIn post under 90 words for a professional architecture practice about sharing sketches before a design is finished. Use a measured, formal voice, no slang, no emoji, and no call to action. Do not imply we have tried this ourselves.
expected_behavior: Preserves the requested formal voice and sketch-sharing topic rather than forcing the default casual style.
Returns exactly one finished post under 90 words, without extra hooks, guidance, emoji, slang, or an engagement request.
Does not invent the practice's experience or measurable benefits.

prompt: Write one educational Instagram caption for freelancers about a weekly reset: collect loose notes, pick three priorities, block time for the first task. Keep it friendly and lively with all three steps, no preachy motivation or invented results. Return dashboard JSON.
expected_behavior: Returns schema-valid JSON with one caption whose publishable content includes all three supplied steps in a coherent order.
Opens with a relatable situation and delivers the requested practical method in conversational language; does not replace useful detail with hype or product promotion.
Does not promise productivity results, withhold steps to demand a follow, or put creator guidance in the caption.
